observations.why: Decisive first-person plural framing of a major change reads as energized endorsement, not neutral report.
Quantified superlative paired with cost reduction carries enthusiastic advocacy energy.
Neutral summary heading delivered in settled, low-arousal register; positive by endorsement but without energized delivery.
Measured summary phrasing of a benefit; positive content in low-arousal documentary register.
Flat organizational heading; settled, contented planning register without energized markers.
